meta.name: pear.no — Identity & Partnership Editorial
meta.description: Editorial one-page identity playbook of a revenue-share SEO/software studio. Open, warm-white ground; restrained serif typography with italic emphasis; chaptered single page; honest 'full disclosure' notes. Used as the TONE/RHYTHM reference, never as pixel copy.

primary.role: ink / primary text on light ground

accent.role: single warm metallic accent (links / small labels)

neutral.usage: warm off-white ground with near-black ink; gray muted body

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant; high contrast ink on warm white; muted text only for secondary editorial copy

font_families.heading: editorial serif with strong italic cut (display)

typography.font_style_notes: Half-normal / half-italic headlines: one clause regular, the counter-clause italic serif. Generous paragraph width (45-75ch). Italic is a semantic device, not decoration.

spacing.section_rhythm: alternating restraint — long quiet sections interrupted by a single loud statement; vertical padding varies chapter to chapter

layout.grid_system: single centred column + full-bleed chapter breaks
layout.alignment_tendency: mixed — centred hero, left-aligned editorial body, asymmetric metadata rows

shape.border_usage: none on surfaces; hairline 1px only on form controls and metadata dividers
shape.divider_style: thin hairline in warm gray between editorial chapters

elevation.depth_cues: color intensity and scale contrast, not shadows

motion.entrance_pattern: content-driven; elements settle with slight upward release
motion.philosophy: editorial — motion serves reading rhythm, never spectacle

components.button_style: text-link CTA (underlined on hover) with single arrow suffix; one primary pill button allowed
components.navigation_pattern: fixed 4-item anchor nav (generation number + label), no hamburger under 768px unless needed
components.modal_style: full-screen dim block, centred single question
components.component_notes: Every claim is followed by an inline 'Full disclosure' note block — honesty is a UI component, not a footnote.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a well-set printed chapter with one live seam

visual_language.ornamentation: none — italic serif is the only ornament
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous and load-bearing (whitespace is the grid)
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: single heavy headline + large quiet planes
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero statement; then progressive calm reveal
visual_language.contrast_level: high tonal contrast, low chromatic contrast

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy via size and italic contrast
composition.flow_direction: top-down vertical, one idea per viewport

interaction_feel.feedback_style: quiet and immediate (link underline, dot state changes)
interaction_feel.loading_style: no spinners; content reveals as it loads

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: candid statement of what is and is not offered

text_effects.description: hero headline letters settle on load; body never animates

visual_effects.composite_notes: pear DNA is intentionally motion-dry. For AICADBridge the WARM GROUND + EDITORIAL SERIF + RHYTHM come from here; the single dark product object will be the only 'live surface', carrying its own neon accents from the UI DNA.
